country_hq: Brazil (Sao Paulo); not Czech and unrelated to Czech Banka Creditas
sector: Fintech: secured consumer lending (originally P2P loans)

rockaway.entity: Rockaway Ventures, startup arm of the Rockaway group (CzechCrunch 2017; pt.wikipedia says Rockaway Capital). A minority venture stake, not a holding/control position.
rockaway.amount: USD 1.4M round total; Rockaway share undisclosed

events.description: First Wayback capture of bankfacil.com.br: pre-launch landing page ("Estamos trabalhando para ajuda-lo a controlar sua vida financeira") with e-mail sign-up.
pt.wikipedia: BankFacil founded April 2012 in Sao Paulo.
CNPJ 17.770.708/0001-24 CREDITAS SOLUCOES LTDA, activity start 2013-01-24 (current name; link to BankFacil is an inference).
Rockaway Ventures bought a minority stake "3.5 years" before 24 Apr 2017 in a USD 1.4M round with Napkn Ventures (derived, approx. Oct 2013). This is T0.
events.note: Derived from a relative statement; pt.wikipedia says only "2013 seed led by Rockaway Capital and Napkn Ventures".

events.description: Series A BRL 10M (about USD 2.9M): Accion Frontier Investments Group and Redpoint eventures (Rockaway not named).
Series B BRL 60M led by IFC with Naspers Fintech; company renamed Creditas.
Exit announced: Rockaway Ventures sells its minority stake at about 10x the original investment (buyer not named).

not_found.what_was_checked: No 2013 announcement of the Rockaway/Napkn investment found (PT and EN searches); it appears only in the 2017 exit article and aggregators. Rockaway exit page URL given in the coordinator file did not load the article (listing page returned).
No pre-T0 press on BankFacil found.
Brazilian JUCESP filings not accessible; investment may have gone through a foreign vehicle; not checked.

next_rounds.lead: Accion Frontier Investments Group, Redpoint eventures

after_investment.notes: Later Series D (SoftBank, 2019) and more per pt.wikipedia.

caveats: Coordinator file lists Creditas with date 2017-04: that is the EXIT announcement (the URL is "announces exit"), not the entry. Entry is about 3.5 years earlier (about Oct 2013, derived, low confidence).
Rockaway entity: CzechCrunch says Rockaway Ventures, pt.wikipedia says Rockaway Capital; whether the EUR 53m fund existed in 2013 is not established, so this is pre-fund group venture money.
Seed size varies: USD 1.4M (cc.cz) vs BRL 3M (Forbes Brasil / Exame, per search summary).
